initialExam.title: SBI SO 2026 (Specialist Officer)
initialExam.description: SBI Specialist Officer recruitment for specialized roles in IT, Law, HR, Marketing, and other departments. Requires domain expertise and relevant professional qualifications.
initialExam.eligibility: Graduate/Post-Graduate in relevant discipline with work experience
initialExam.syllabus: Professional Knowledge (domain-specific), Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language.
initialExam.examPattern: Online Written Test: 150 questions, 150 marks, 2.5 hours. Interview: 50 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Written Test → Interview → Document Verification → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Specialist Officer in IT, Law, HR, Marketing, Risk Management departments
initialExam.careerGrowth: MMGS-II → MMGS-III → SMGS-IV → SMGS-V → TEGS-VI → TEGS-VII.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit sbi.co.in 2. Register 3. Fill application 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, CCA, Medical, LFC, Pension (NPS), Vehicle Loan, Housing Loan

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
